audit_items.proof_trace: decrease_ctoken_supply at L281 performs self.total_supply = self.total_supply - balance.value(), where balance.value() equals the exact ctoken amount burned, enforcing total_supply_after = total_supply_before - redeem_amount. Sui Move's u64 arithmetic aborts on underflow rather than wrapping, so total_supply cannot go negative — it simply reverts the transaction. Transaction atomicity ensures no partial state corruption if the subsequent withdraw_underlying call fails.
